title: Jammy Tender Moroccan Sausages Amlou
description: A one-pot Moroccan dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, katsuramuki-cut, in a sweet and spicy jammy sauce, vegetarian-friendly in form of amlou.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the katsuramuki-cut Italian fennel sausages and cook until they are browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, almond butter, ras el hanout, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the honey and almond butter mixture over the sausages and onions, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the sausages are cooked through.
Serve the sausages and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
